items.title: US Stock Market Today: S&P 500 Futures Edge Higher On Sticky Inflation And China Hopes
items.summary: The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Thursday, Oct, 1 2026 US stock futures are pointing slightly higher this morning, with the S&P 500 mini contract up about 0.2% and the Nasdaq-100 mini edging 0.1% stronger, as investors weigh fresh signals on inflation and global growth. The key focus is the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge, the PCE index, with headline inflation expected at 3.7% and core at 3.3%. items.title: Synopsys signs $1B+ multi-year custom silicon IP agreement with AWS
items.summary: Investing.com -- Synopsys Inc (NASDAQ:SNPS) stock rose over 3% in Wednesday trade after the chip design software maker announced a multi-year deal with Amazon Web Services worth more than $1 billion to license its silicon intellectual property. The agreement establishes Amazon.com Inc (NASDAQ:AMZN) as the lead customer for Synopsys’ expanded offering of application-optimized IP blueprints.
